title: We Lied to Skip Our Final Exam 📝
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #college #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: The night before our final exam, my best friend and I went to a party instead of studying.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head dancing at a party at night, books abandoned on a table

scenes.text: We woke up at noon. The exam had started at nine.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head waking up in panic, a clock showing noon

scenes.text: So we went to the professor and told him, sir, we had a flat tire on the way. We were stuck for hours.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head pretending to be sad in front of a clever old professor with a white beard and a tweed jacket in his office

scenes.text: He smiled and said, no problem. You can take the exam tomorrow.
scenes.image: a clever old professor with a white beard and a tweed jacket smiling kindly, almost too kindly

scenes.text: We celebrated. One extra day to study. Easy.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head high-fiving in a hallway

scenes.text: The next day, he put us in two separate rooms.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head being led into two different empty classrooms by a clever old professor with a white beard and a tweed jacket

scenes.text: The first question was easy, worth five points. Then I turned the page. Question two, worth ninety-five points.
scenes.image: a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap at a desk turning an exam page, confident face changing to fear

close-up of an exam paper, a sleepy college student about 20 with a backwards cap sweating in one room and a college student about 20 with curly hair and sunglasses on his head sweating in another, split screen
